BASIC [[image filename.png]]

LEFT [[<image filename.png]]
RIGHT [[>image filename.png]]
CENTER [[=image filename.png]]

FLOAT LEFT [[f<image landscape.jpg]]
FLOAT RIGHT [[f>image landscape.jpg]]

EXTERNAL [[image https://example.com/some-image.webp]]
FILE_1 [[image /my-picture.png]]
FILE_2 [[image /some-other-page/my-picture.png]]
FILE_2 [[image  some-other-page/my-picture.png]]
FILE_3 [[image /scp-wiki/some-other-page/my-picture.png]]
FILE_3 [[image  scp-wiki/some-other-page/my-picture.png]]

ATTRS [[image foo.gif class="animated" style="border: 1em solid" data-xyz="bar" alt="A foobar made of gold" title="FOO"]]

LINK [[image foo.gif link="#gif-sucks"]]
LINK [[image foo.gif link="some-page"]]
LINK [[image foo.gif link="https://example.com/"]]
LINK [[image foo.gif link=" https://example.com/"]]

NEW_LINK [[image foo.gif link="*https://example.com/"]]
NEW_LINK [[image foo.gif link="* https://example.com/"]]
